blocks.text: Eligibility: Intermediate from any recognized university or 10+2 from any recognized education board.

The programme offers a diverse range of subjects, such as History, Economics, Politics, Geography, and Public Administration, designed to prepare students for careers in fields like law, journalism, academia, civil services, and research.

A blend of traditional and modern teaching methods with interactive sessions, seminars, role-plays, debates, and workshops. Evaluation is based on regular tests, internal assessments, and practical activities.

Students will develop critical thinking skills and gain knowledge in areas such as civilization, culture, social behavior, literature, and politics. Graduates can pursue careers in civil services, research, and further postgraduate studies.
Location: Block 2, UG and Administration Building
Library: Vast collection of books with annual updates
Computer Lab: Internet-enabled for student use
Seminar Hall: Equipped with modern AV tools and LCD projectors
The Career Guidance and Placement Cell (CGPC) connects students with industry professionals through periodic placement drives and off-campus opportunities.
Mock Parliament: Students represent political leaders and debate current issues.
Mock Budget Session: An event where students review policy-making in Indian administration and economy, presenting a mock budget session.
Budget-Review Session: An interactive session on the country's annual budget is held, after which students submit their reviews to the respective teachers.

The Bachelor of Arts programme at Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College is designed to provide a well-rounded education, fostering both academic and personal growth in a supportive and resource-rich environment.
Eligibility Criteria: 10+2 or equivalent examination from any recognized board or council in any discipline

The Commerce stream is a vital branch of higher education and one of the most sought-after study programmes, producing commercial experts who contribute significantly to the service sector, which accounts for over 60% of the GDP. This programme focuses on the study of trade and business activities, encompassing the exchange of goods and services from producers to final consumers.

Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College launched its Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com.) course in 1973. The programme is affiliated to Andhra University and is designed to equip students with a wide range of managerial skills and specialized knowledge in various business areas.
The curriculum covers a broad spectrum of subjects within the commerce domain, including:
Skill courses such as entrepreneurship development, business writing, marketing skills, project management, and digital marketing
Language studies include English and a second language (Telugu, Hindi, or Sanskrit)

The Commerce Department fosters a stimulating academic environment for its students. Faculty members are experts in accounting, finance, and other commerce-related subjects. Regular guest lectures, seminars, presentations, and business line paper reviews are organized to enhance students' skills.

Students are inspired to aspire Big. Graduates are groomed to envisage themselves for careers as Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, Cost and Management Accountants, Business Administrators, and leaders in national and international organizations. They are also prepared for roles in accounting, banking, and financial management sectors immediately upon graduation. The career scope is extensive, covering various industries.

The Commerce Department is staffed by experienced and dedicated faculty members. Each faculty member is assigned a group of students to provide personal attention, guidance, and training for success in a competitive world. Faculty members actively engage in research and publish in leading journals, regularly participating and presenting research papers in national seminars to stay current with management theory and practice.
In addition to the university-prescribed curriculum, the department offers several unique features:
1. Add-On Courses: Although not part of the university curriculum, these courses are crucial for practical application in the professional world. The department offers the following add-on courses:
2. Case Studies from Harvard Business Review: Each week, a case study published in the Harvard Business Review is discussed in the classroom, followed by interactive sessions.

The department conducts three unique competitions in honour of Sri V.B.V. Reddy, the former president of the college. These competitions are designed to test students' knowledge and competence in various areas:
Test on Knowledge of Current Corporate Affairs
Test on Knowledge in Elements of Commerce

These competitions are open to students from the Visakhapatnam district with no entry fee. Each question paper contains 100 multiple-choice questions, and OMR sheets are provided for marking answers, which are evaluated using an OMR scanner.

Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College’s Bachelor of Commerce programme is committed to providing a comprehensive education that prepares students for successful careers and leadership roles in the business world.
Eligibility Criteria: 10+2 or higher secondary equivalent examination in Science from any recognized board or council

The Bachelor of Science (B. Sc. Honours) degree programme at Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College, affiliated to Andhra University, provides a solid foundation in multiple scientific disciplines and the latest advancements in science and technology. The programme offers the following:

A degree in Bachelor of Science equips students with essential skills such as observation, analysis, experimentation, problem-solving, logic, and research. Graduates can pursue careers in diverse fields including healthcare, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, agriculture, food industry, chemical industry, research firms, testing laboratories, wastewater management, oil industry, automobile industry, geological surveys, environmental management, forensic science, space research, banking, finance, and treasury management. Post acquisition of the degree, one is eligible to pursue any profession and any field of study. Further education, such as an M. Sc. degree, can enhance job prospects and open up additional opportunities.

The B. Sc. programme ensures an enriching learning experience through interactive classroom sessions and practical laboratory work. Seminars and workshops by eminent senior professors are organized throughout the year. The faculty comprises highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated professionals. Modern teaching tools such as LCD screens, audio-visual gadgets, and the latest technology enhance the presentation of topics by the faculty. To optimize the learning experience, students are assigned various projects and regular assignments, which help develop their skills. In addition to regular tests and internal assessments, students are evaluated on their practical and creative skills. English is mandatory for language studies, while students can choose between Telugu, Hindi, and Sanskrit for the second language. Laboratory sessions are highly prioritized for all domain papers.

The department boasts well-furnished classrooms, seminar halls, and a well-stocked library. Laboratories are a crucial component of the science curricula, and the college provides multiple labs for each department, including Computer Science, Chemistry, Physics, Electronics, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Botany, and Zoology. Block 1 is dedicated to housing these laboratories, with additional spaces in other blocks as needed.

Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College's science laboratories are among the best in Andhra Pradesh, equipped with advanced and rare equipment to support robust scientific and research-based learning. These labs offer a flexible framework to accommodate dynamic student work groups and research activities.

The Bachelor of Science programme at Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College is committed to providing a comprehensive education that prepares students for successful careers and further studies in various scientific fields.
Bachelor of Business Administration Programme Overview
Eligibility Criteria: 10+2 or higher secondary equivalent examination in Science from any recognized board or council

The Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme was established in 1992. Since its inception, the department has maintained high standards in terms of quality and results. The department focuses not only on academic excellence but also on enhancing students' core competencies. Faculty members, known for their expertise in accounting, finance, and other commerce-related subjects, impart practical knowledge to students. To further develop student skills, the department conducts talks, paper and computer presentations, and Business Line news reviews. The objective in commerce and management education is to promote managerial skills, work ethics, professional expertise, and leadership in all areas of life.

The Department of Management integrates classroom learning with real-world business challenges through industry visits, guest lecture series, projects, and internships. Students are taught how to manage people, motivate employees, resolve conflicts, and build team morale. Additionally, they gain knowledge in finance and accounting. Students have the opportunity to specialize in specific areas of business, such as marketing, human resources, information technology, or other fields, enhancing their job readiness. A Bachelor of Business Administration from Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College equips students with essential skills that are invaluable across various business sectors, preparing them for successful careers.
Location: Block 2, UG and Administration Building
Library: The department library has a vast collection of books with new editions added annually.
Computer Lab: Equipped with internet facilities to support student learning and online examination systems.
Seminar Hall: A seminar hall furnished with the latest audio-visual technology, LCD projectors, and comfortable seating arrangements for digital classes, seminars, guest lectures, and workshops.

The Undergraduate Library at Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College is a vibrant resource centre designed to support the academic and research needs of students across a variety of disciplines. Offering a wide collection of textbooks, reference materials, journals, and e-resources, the library provides an enriching environment for study and exploration. It caters to students in fields such as Science, Commerce, Arts, Management, and Computer Science, with dedicated sections for each subject area. The library staff are always available to guide students in locating resources and improving their research skills.

In addition to academic resources, the library promotes holistic learning by offering materials on personal development, career guidance, and extracurricular interests. Whether for exam preparation, project work, or personal study, the Undergraduate Library is a key hub for fostering academic excellence and intellectual curiosity at the college.
